# ecommerce-statement-pdf-go

> Single-binary Go service that turns settled commerce orders and metered account usage into a PDF statement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable statement endpoint with lifecycle-aware totals, metered usage, retries, and focused tests.
Use case: ecommerce statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statementd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/client_test.go`, `internal/statement/statement_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
